review_notes: Lithuanian Airports (LTOU) reports 2025 passenger flights at Kaunas; airport-specific 2024 air cargo handled 5200 tonnes. Airfreight evidence does not imply unconstrained cargo aircraft or nightly slots.
Kėdainiai Air Base is military-labelled in the runway source. Current commercial civilian access, passengers and cargo operations are not verified.
LTOU records 2025 Palanga scheduled and charter passenger activity and airport-specific 2024 airfreight of 472 tonnes. Cargo YES means observed cargo handling, not regular dedicated cargo flights.
Panevėžys Air Base is military-labelled in the runway source. Current commercial civilian access, passengers and cargo operations are not verified.
LTOU reports 2025 Vilnius passenger traffic and 2024 airport-specific air cargo 16300 tonnes; existing capacity and legal restrictions must be checked separately.

Siauliai municipal airport operator has Lithuanian government authorization to serve civil air transport within a military aerodrome; documents passenger-handling and dedicated cargo-handling/customs. No regular scheduled passenger flights are proven by this evidence. Dual military/civil use entails coordination.

Lux-Airport documents commercial passenger routes and major Cargolux freight handling; 2026 Luxembourg government airport masterplan discusses existing passenger and cargo terminals. No hourly capacity or curfew inferred.
Bălți-Leadoveni runway meets physical minimum, but no current official commercial passenger/cargo permission or schedule was established from reviewed Moldovan regulator listing. Not activated.

Moldovan CAA reports 2025 Chisinau scheduled passenger operations and licensed cargo/mail ground handling; both passenger and freight services are documented. AIP slot and restriction details remain pending.

CAA Moldova lists certified cargo/mail ground handler at Mărculești (except dangerous goods). Aerodrome permit P-0004/2025 valid to 2026-12-08 expressly PROHIBITS outbound international departures carrying checked baggage, goods, mail or onboard supplies. This is restricted cargo-handling capability, NOT an approved international cargo departure airport; passenger service remains UNKNOWN. Mandatory game route restriction review before activation.

Malta NSO publishes 2025 airport-specific passenger movements; 2026 official Malta AIP AD 2.4 explicitly lists cargo loaders/handling facilities and H24 handling/customs. Specific airline cargo rights and noise curfews require separate review.
